rules.rationale: Per-user temporary directory (/var/folders/.../T); applications recreate contents as needed.
Per-user application caches (includes browser web caches); Apple guidelines require apps to regenerate anything stored here. Preferences, logins and documents are untouched.
Per-user application logs and diagnostic reports; only useful for debugging past problems.
Window-restore state snapshots; macOS rebuilds them the next time each app runs.
Xcode build products and indexes; fully regenerated by the next build. Source code and projects are untouched.
